messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Subject: Apology for My Earlier Comment  

Hi [Colleague’s Name],

I wanted to apologize for the remark I made during yesterday’s meeting. It was inconsiderate and did not reflect the respect I have for you and our team. I value your contributions and regret any discomfort I caused. Please let me know if there’s anything I can do to make things right.

Thank you for understanding.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]

PLAN:
- Identify the key points to include in the apology.
- Draft a concise subject line and opening.
- Write the body acknowledging the mistake and expressing regret.
- Close with a willingness to make amends and a polite sign‑off.
- Review the email for tone and brevity.
